question: Whom did Ram Nath Kovind defeat to become the 14th President of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meira Kumar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• Ram Nath Kovind is the 14th President of India.
 
• Last presidential election held on **17th July 2017. **
 
• He was earlier the Governor of Bihar.
 
• He is a successor of former President Pranab Mukherjee.
 
• Mr Kovind was a lawyer by profession.
 
• In the presidential election, he was backed by National Democratic Alliance.
 
• **Meira Kumar was the** **first women speaker **of Lok Sabha from 2009 to 2014. She has earlier served as Minister of Social Justice and Empowerment in UPA government from 2004 to 2009.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Term of President is five years**, although he can be re-elected by the members of the electoral college.
 
• President can be impeached for violation of the Constitution under **Article 61**.
 
• In his absence, Vice President holds his power and if Vice President is also not available then the Chief Justice of India will hold the office of the president.
